name: 客服平均响应时间/解决率统计

map.📖 查看「客服平均响应时间/解决率统计使用指南」: 📖 View the "Support Response Time Statistics Guide"
map.平均响应 = Σ 单次时长 / 次数 · 达标率 = (≤ 阈值次数 / 总次数: Mean response = Σ single duration / count　·　compliance rate = (count within threshold / total count) x 100%
map.单次响应时长（秒，逗号或换行分隔）: Single response duration (seconds, comma- or newline-separated)
map.20 个工单响应时长均值 26 分钟、中位数 9 分钟、最大值 210 分钟；中: For 20 tickets the mean response is 26 minutes, the median 9 minutes and the maximum 210 minutes; the median better represents the typical experience, and those very long tickets should be investigated separately (e.g. no staff on duty at night).
map.改版前标准差 34、改版后 12，均值均由 20 降到 15；波动收窄说明流程改: The standard deviation fell from 34 before the change to 12 after, and the mean from 20 to 15; narrower variation shows the process change really worked rather than merely coinciding with easy tickets.
map.响应时长和解决率能一起算吗？: Can response time and resolution rate be computed together?
map.页面只做数值统计、不区分指标类型；建议分两批输入（一批响应时长、一批是否解决的: The page only runs numeric statistics and does not distinguish metric types; enter two batches (one of response times, one of 1/0 resolved flags) and take the means separately, where the latter mean is the resolution rate.
map.单位需要统一吗？: Do the units need to be unified?
map.样本太少结果可信吗？: Is the result reliable with too few samples?
map.汇总首响与解决时长，输出均值/中位数/P90: Summarise first-response and resolution times with mean / median / P90
map.纯前端处理，数据不出本地: Fully client-side; data never leaves your device
map.团队与个人绩效短板定位: Pinpointing team and individual performance gaps
map.把客服首响（或平均响应）时长逐条录入，计算平均响应、中位数、P90 与 SLA: Enter each first-response (or average response) duration to compute the mean, median, P90 and SLA hit rate, then use the period's total tickets and first-contact resolutions for the FCR, for SLA and resolution-capability reviews; all processing stays in the browser.
map.平均响应 = Σ 单次时长 / 次数 · P90 = 排序后第 0.9×(n−1: Mean response = Σ durations / count · P90 = linear interpolation at position 0.9×(n−1) of the sorted list · Hit rate = (count ≤ threshold / total) × 100% · FCR = first-contact resolutions / total tickets × 100%
map.P90 表示 90% 的工单响应不超过该值；SLA 达标率与 FCR 分别衡量时: P90 means 90% of tickets respond within this value; the SLA hit rate and FCR measure timeliness and first-contact resolution separately, so review them apart.
map.贴入一天内所有工单的首次响应时长（秒），用均值、中位数与 P90 判断整体时效；: Paste every ticket's first-response duration (in seconds) for a day and judge overall timeliness by mean, median and P90; P90 reflects the long tail better than the mean.
map.录入本期工单总数与首次解决数，算首次解决率（FCR），与 SLA 达标率一起复盘: Enter the period's total tickets and first-contact resolutions to get FCR, and review “fast but unresolved” cases together with the SLA hit rate.
map.默认数据：均值被长尾拉高，P90 更接近体感: Default data: the mean is pulled up by the long tail, P90 feels truer
map.13 条响应（3–210 秒）、阈值 60 秒 → 均值 37.46 秒、中位数: 13 responses (3–210 s) with a 60 s threshold → mean 37.46 s, median 18 s, P90 70.40 s, 11 within SLA (84.6%), 2 overdue; 50 tickets, 42 first-contact resolutions → FCR 84.0%. The 210 s case pulls the mean up, while P90 reflects what most users actually wait.
map.技术支持 4 小时 SLA：P90 已破线: 4-hour support SLA: P90 already breaches the line
map.10 条工单（37–480 秒）、阈值 240 秒 → 均值 161.20 秒、: 10 tickets (37–480 s) with a 240 s threshold → mean 161.20 s, median 107 s, P90 336 s, 8 within SLA (80.0%); 20 tickets, 15 first-contact resolutions → FCR 75.0%. P90 exceeds the threshold, so roughly a tenth of tickets still breach the SLA; staff or route that long tail separately.
map.可以：时长序列用于均值、中位数、P90 与达标率；工单总数与首次解决工单数单独计: Yes: the duration list feeds the mean, median, P90 and hit rate; total tickets and first-contact resolutions separately give the FCR. Keep the two sets of metrics independent and never mix 0/1 flags into the durations.
map.必须统一。混贴秒与分钟会让均值、P90 和达标率完全失真，建议先换算成同一单位（: They must match. Mixing seconds and minutes distorts the mean, P90 and hit rate; convert to one unit first (this tool uses seconds).
map.P90 至少要 10 条样本才有参考意义；十几条样本的离散度本身波动很大，建议积: P90 needs at least 10 samples to be meaningful; a dozen samples fluctuate a lot, so accumulate a full period (e.g. a week) before drawing conclusions and keep the raw data for review.
map.与 P90 判断整体时效；P90 比均值更能反映长尾体验。: and P90 to judge overall timeliness; P90 reflects long-tail experience better than the mean.
